name: CagriSema (Cagrilintide + Semaglutide)
storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: CagriSema (Cagrilintide + Semaglutide) (CS) is a multi-component peptide blend supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 3 pack sizes: 5 mg, 10 mg, 20 mg. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Each unit combines Cagrilintide and Semaglutide in equal parts. Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is CagriSema (Cagrilintide + Semaglutide) tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: Each lot of CagriSema (Cagrilintide + Semaglutide) is analysed by HPLC for purity and by mass spectrometry for identity. The lot-specific certificate of analysis reports the measured purity, retention time, molecular mass and appearance. Catalogue purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC).

faq.question: How should CagriSema (Cagrilintide + Semaglutide) be stored?
faq.answer: Store the lyophilized powder at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture. After reconstitution, keep the solution at 2-8 °C and use it within the period stated in the lot certificate of analysis. Avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles. This product is for laboratory research use only.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for CagriSema (Cagrilintide + Semaglutide)?
faq.answer: CagriSema (Cagrilintide + Semaglutide) is available in 3 configurations: 5 mg, 10 mg, 20 mg. Each kit contains 10 vials. Minimum order quantity is 1 kit. Volume pricing applies to 10-49 kits and 50+ kits.
